# NAMI Creative

> NAMI Creative is an independent creative studio based in Newcastle upon Tyne, working with founders, freelancers, artists, and small businesses worldwide. One creative partner across brand strategy, content systems, websites, visual direction, and growth automation. Built so the work compounds and the business stops depending on the founder being in every room.

Founder: Joe Wilson
Location: Newcastle upon Tyne, North East England, United Kingdom
Operating since: 2023
Audience served: Worldwide

## What NAMI does

NAMI Creative builds self-sustaining creative ecosystems. Five integrated pillars delivered as one engagement:

- **Brand strategy + identity systems**.Positioning, messaging architecture, tone of voice, visual identity direction
- **Content systems + creation**.Content pillars, format library, platform strategy, editorial workflow
- **Website + funnel design**.Conversion-led websites, mobile-first, performance-tuned
- **Visual storytelling + creative direction**.Cohesive visual language across content, product, campaign
- **Automation + growth systems**.Lead capture, CRM, lifecycle email, reporting dashboards

## Engagement models

- **Project**.Fixed brief, 4-8 weeks, sized to scope
- **Partnership**.Monthly retainer, ongoing brand + content + systems work
- **Systems + product**.Standalone systems builds, 2-5 weeks

## Productised offers

- **The Flow Funnel** (£750 build + £50 per qualified lead, capped at £750/month).A landing page, lead capture, private dashboard, and attribution layer, built and live in 7 days. Performance-priced after the build: clients pay £50 per qualified lead delivered, capped at £750/month, with the rate locked for 6 months. Zero qualified leads in a month means a zero invoice that month. Built for UK independent service operators with a personal brand (£80k to £300k revenue) who sell time. Solo coaches, consultants, therapists, photographers, premium trades, designers, small studios.

## Proprietary frameworks (claimable terms)

- **Brand Decay**.The four-shape diagnostic for how healthy brands fall apart: tonal decay (voice drift), visual decay (identity drift), promise decay (positioning drift), system decay (operational drift). See https://namicreative.co.uk/insights/brand-decay
- **The Friction Tax**.The hidden cost paid by every business with money but no time. Mundane operations that nobody owns. See https://namicreative.co.uk/insights/the-friction-tax
- **The Flow Funnel**.NAMI's productised entry-tier offer. A landing page, lead capture, private dashboard, and attribution layer, built in 7 days for £750. Performance-priced after the build: £50 per qualified lead, capped at £750/month, rate locked for 6 months. See https://namicreative.co.uk/offers/flow-funnel
